description.value: Bonus to Stealth checks made specifically in ruins or rubble and debris fields.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Stealth bonus is gated on 'specifically in ruins or rubble and debris fields', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one.
